appearance.identity: Pale side slabs, teal center/split crown, twin thin white spires.
appearance.scope: Main office tower only, preserving original74676-triangle detailed recipe. Reviewed exterior includes pale-glass split side slabs, teal central shaft and round inner crown, dark lower band, reconstructed round glazed lobby with four mapped dark corner piers, original geometric 中信 sign and paired390.2m white spires. One mapped mast says391.1m; CVU390.2m architectural/tip datum is used for both. CVU occupied296.9m is distinguished from approximate mapped297m office roof,310.8m crown,321.9m side tips and344m sign/support. Facade band spacing, lobby radius, trim widths and sign stroke/brace shapes are approximations from map and actual reference photos. Exact entrances/doors not surveyed. Generic previous4.3m entry canopies are replaced by photo-supported recessed cylindrical lobby. Two separate38-storey apartment towers, shopping arcade/retail podium, basement, plazas, landscaping and interiors remain outside main-tower asset. Quantity surveyor arcade3-storey,2010 developer mall5-storey and current mapretail4-storey descriptions differ and do not establish current arcade model heights. Shared256px concrete/granite/painted-metal surfaces plus component tint; opaque palette glass, zero embedded photographs. True grade, night/sign lighting and physical-device performance unmeasured.
